customer.text: how many videos can I use and what should I send after payment

historyBefore.text:
Thanks for choosing TikTok ads management with a 5,000 daily budget for 7 days.

Just to confirm, you want Joshspot Media to run and manage the TikTok ad campaigns for you, right? Also, do you have any preference for the number of creatives (ad variations) you want us to test or run? This helps me prepare an accurate quote for you.

You mentioned "send account." Just to clarify, do you want us to set up a new TikTok ad account for managing your campaigns, or do you have an existing TikTok ad account that you want us to manage? 

This will help me provide the right next steps or prepare your quote accordingly.
does that amount include ad money

The 5,000 daily budget you mentioned for TikTok ads management does not include the ad spend itself. It refers to the amount allocated to run and manage your ad campaigns. The ad spend is separate and goes directly into the ads on TikTok.

Would you like me to prepare a detailed quote including both the management service fee and the ad spend for 7 days? Also, please confirm if you want us to set up a new TikTok ad account or manage an existing one.

content.text:
You can use multiple videos (creatives) in your TikTok ad campaigns to test which performs best. Usually, starting with 3 to 5 video creatives is ideal, but you can send more if you have them. 

After payment, you’ll need to provide your video creatives in the recommended formats along with any captions or key messages you want included in the ads. If you want, I can guide you on the exact file specs and other details after we finalize your purchase.

Would you like me to prepare a detailed quote including management plus your 5k daily ad spend for 7 days? Also, please confirm if you want us to set up a new TikTok ad account or manage an existing one.
